predicate.statistic: cosine of the release to its best phrase minus its cosine to its record's kind; 0 when the kinds match
predicate.record_kind: commonest best phrase among the record's largest kept cluster, ties to the higher mean cosine
predicate.rule: release only where the statistic exceeds the gate, that is where the kinds differ
predicate.pass: among judged right and wrong releases the gate keeps at least 50% of wrong releases and still releases at least 80% of right releases
predicate.review: frozen release_audit.json on the fresh proposal
predicate.confirm: the same rule and thresholds on both older folds, judged by the older look labels; both must pass
predicate.auc: reported only; no threshold or phrase list is chosen from it
predicate.phrases: PHRASES, fixed before embedding; written by an agent who had seen the review sheets
